newsitem.title: UK: Matthew Clark slides after profits warning.
newsitem.headline: Matthew Clark slides after profits warning.

text.p: Shares in Matthew Clark Plc slumped on Tuesday after the company said that increased competition in the branded drinks market could materially affect full year results, traders said.
By 1039 GMT, the shares had slid 192-1/2p to 477-1/2p down nearly 29 percent.
Shares in Bulmer HP Holdings also fell after the warning at Matthew Clark's annual meeting, slipping 40-1/2p to 540, off nearly seven percent
